title: Databases and Caching
description: Use Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and Azure Cache for Redis to build data-backed applications.
longDescription: This module covers Azure database and caching services. You will learn how to provision Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB, design schemas and partition strategies, secure connections with managed identities, improve performance with caching, and plan data migrations.
whatYouLearn: Provision and connect to Azure SQL Database
Design Cosmos DB containers and partition keys
Choose consistency levels and distribution modes
Use Azure Cache for Redis to improve application performance
Secure database access with managed identities
Plan database migrations with Azure Database Migration Service
